caption: The video captures a dim indoor scene centered on a white, glitter-flecked dome-shaped foam object resting on a folded yellow terry-cloth towel with a ribbed band. In the dark upper background a spoked motorcycle wheel shows a bright reflective highlight, while a partial letter 'R' appears at the right edge. Throughout the excerpt the dome remains in continuous contact with the towel, showing no bounce, squeeze, roll, or detachment. Its overall outline and position relative to the towel folds stay essentially constant, with only very small apparent framing shifts that suggest mild camera jitter. The bright glitter specks on the dome's surface change subtly from frame to frame, reflecting minor variations in lighting and viewing angle rather than a clear rotation. No deformation, expansion, or translation of the dome beyond this noise is visible. The scene therefore holds in this settled state for the full duration shown.
relations: The white foam dome maintains continuous contact with the folded yellow towel throughout the clip.
The dome's position and shape remain essentially constant, showing no bounce, roll, or detachment.
Bright glitter specks shift subtly due to minor lighting and viewing angle variations.
Small framing shifts suggest mild camera jitter rather than actual movement of the dome.
